name: Alliance Trauma
summary: Across the Alliance, accomplished medics are sent to Theramore Isle for service. There, you study under Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen, chief physician of the Alliance's elite medical corps.

sections.title: A Call to the Field
sections.body: Your skill with needle, cloth, and triage has drawn Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen's notice. From Theramore Isle, he leads Alliance Trauma, caring for the wounded in Kalimdor's fiercest warzones and beyond.

sections.title: The Road to Theramore
sections.body:
In Ironforge, Nissa Firestone treats VanHowzen's personal summons as a rare privilege. Theramore Isle faces regional threats, skirmishes, and harsh wilderness, so grievously wounded soldiers arrive in a steady stream.

You cross the sea to Dustwallow Marsh. There, VanHowzen tests how calmly you assess the wounded against his rigorous triage standards.

faq.answer: Alliance Trauma is the Alliance's elite medical corps, devoted to battlefield medicine and emergency triage. Chief Physician Gustaf VanHowzen leads it, treating critical wounds ordinary field dressings cannot manage.

faq.q: Who sends you on this quest?
faq.answer: Alliance first aid instructors send promising practitioners after they master the standard training in their cities. Nissa Firestone in Ironforge is one such instructor.

faq.q: Where do you have to travel?
faq.answer: You travel to Theramore Isle, a human port fortress on Kalimdor's eastern coast in Dustwallow Marsh.

Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen leads Alliance Trauma as its chief physician. He works at the military clinic in Theramore and is among the Alliance's foremost authorities on emergency medicine and surgical triage.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Doctor VanHowzen?
faq.answer: At Theramore, VanHowzen gives candidates a hands-on triage evaluation. They must show they can save waves of dying soldiers before he admits them to the upper ranks of field medicine.

faq.q: Why is the clinic based in Theramore instead of Stormwind or Ironforge?
faq.answer: Theramore is an active frontier garrison amid hostile marshlands, dangerous beasts, and territorial skirmishes. Critically wounded troops arrive constantly, giving its clinic the steady pressure needed for advanced trauma training.

angles.text: Alliance Trauma gives frontline fighters across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms access to skilled medics. They can stabilize critical injuries under fire.
As a dwarf, you may catch the eye of instructors like Nissa Firestone in Ironforge. She seeks promising practitioners from the Great Forge for medical service in Theramore.
